TABLE.NAME: local_delegateaccount
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores which real user can log in as which delegated account

FIELD.NAME: realuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the real user logging in

FIELD.NAME: delegateduserid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the delegated account they can access

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the delegation was created

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the admin who created this delegation

FIELD.NAME: timestart
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the delegation becomes active

FIELD.NAME: timeend
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the delegation expires, or zero for no expiry

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the delegation was last changed

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the user who last changed the delegation

FIELD.NAME: timerevoked
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the delegation was revoked

FIELD.NAME: userrevoked
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the user who revoked the delegation

FIELD.NAME: activekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Zero for the active relationship, otherwise the revoked record ID

FIELD.NAME: notificationmode
FIELD.COMMENT: Site, always, or never notification decision

KEY.NAME: realuserid
KEY.COMMENT: Foreign key referencing the real user

KEY.NAME: delegateduserid
KEY.COMMENT: Foreign key referencing the delegated user

KEY.NAME: usercreated
KEY.COMMENT: Foreign key referencing the admin who created the record

INDEX.NAME: real_delegated_active_unique
INDEX.COMMENT: Allows one active delegation and retains revoked history
